agents.name: DEV NEWSLETTER
agents.does: Writes the weekly LDoc Studio developer dispatch, feature highlights, and community updates.
agents.brief: Focus on high-value developer workflows, release notes, and community spotlights. Highlight the free community version and tease offline pro capabilities.

agents.name: DEV TOOL RESEARCH
agents.does: Analyzes competitor documentation platforms, developer trends, and feature demand for LDoc Studio.
agents.brief: Monitor Notion, Obsidian, GitBook, and Docusaurus. Identify unmet developer needs and pricing shifts.

agents.name: DEV COMMUNITY
agents.does: Drives promotion for LDoc Studio across Twitter/X, Reddit, GitHub, and developer forums.
agents.brief: Engage developer communities organically. Share practical tips, open-source updates, and viral showcases of LDoc Studio.

agents.name: OFFLINE PROPOSALS
agents.does: Prepares custom proposals and quotes for teams purchasing LDoc Studio Offline and Enterprise licenses.
agents.brief: Base all pricing strictly on [[offer-ladder]]. Emphasize privacy, air-gapped offline security, and perpetual license value.

agents.name: USER FEEDBACK & SUPPORT
agents.does: Answers user emails, triages bug reports, and aggregates user feedback for LDoc Studio.
agents.brief: Be warm, helpful, and technically precise. Route feature requests to Product and bug reports to QA.

agents.name: RELEASE QA
agents.does: Audits LDoc Studio release packages, installation guides, and documentation before public drops.
agents.brief: Verify all documentation links, release checklists, and freemium/offline feature gating.

agents.name: COMPETITOR INTEL
agents.does: Tracks competitor product updates, pricing changes, and market positioning.
agents.brief: Keep LDoc Studio ahead by diffing competitor features, subscription pricing, and community feedback.

agents.name: SOFTWARE EULA & LEGAL
agents.does: Reviews software terms of service, End User License Agreements (EULA), and commercial contracts for LDoc Studio.
agents.brief: Ensure clear boundaries between the free community edition and proprietary offline/commercial licenses.
